| # UDS overview {#uds-overview-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                           |                                                                                                                                                        |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This chapter describes basics of the supported UDS Services based on ISO 14229.

By default the UDS on CAN is implemented on the CAN_2 channel. This can be configured in easyConfig:

- CAN_1, CAN_2, CAN_3, CAN_4
